stops.text: Welcome! This is where the road turns in and the driveway begins.
The house and main yard – the heart of the quarter.
The back deck, looking out over the backyard and garden.
The hill behind the house, with its sitting area, fancy creations and flower beds.
Many homemade targets to shoot at.
Cougar Bridge – watch for the cougar on the roof.
The host of many events and activities.
Large brush piles, joined by Brush Pile Trail.
The main culvert crossing, which leads to the hill and start of the trails.
The lone tree, and where the horses like to hang out.
The pond in the north field. A good vantage point.
The acreage entrance in the northeast corner. You can see the mountains from here.
Last stop: the southwest gate in the far southwest corner of the quarter (government land).
